title: CXL.mem Type 3 device transaction layer: M2S Req and RwD in, S2M NDR and DRS out, host-managed device memory with a 2-bit meta state, poison and an HDM range decoder

fields.desc: first host line address (byte address bits 21:6) of the device's LINES = 16 lines; change it only while no message is in flight

regs.name: REQ
regs.desc: M2S Req message; writing REQ1 sends it (the core holds up to RQD = 4 requests)

fdesc.req_opcode: MemInv 0, MemRd 1, MemRdData 2, MemSpecRd 8, MemInvNT 9, MemClnEvct 10 (others are dropped: ERR_OPCODE)
fdesc.req_meta_field: Meta0-State 00, No-Op 11 (01, 10: ERR_PROTO, taken as No-Op)
fdesc.req_meta_value: new meta state for Meta0-State: Invalid 00, Any 10, Shared 11

regs.name: RWD
regs.desc: One beat of an M2S RwD message (8 beats of 8 bytes, beat 0 first); writing RWD3 sends the beat. The header fields are taken from beat 0; RWD0 need not be written again for beats 1..7

regs.name: NDR
regs.desc: S2M NDR message (completion of MemInv, MemInvNT, MemClnEvct, MemWr, MemWrPtl); reading it pops it

fdesc.ndr_meta_value: the line's meta state before the request

regs.name: DRS
regs.desc: One beat of an S2M DRS MemData message (8 beats per line); reading DRS2 pops it

fdesc.drs_meta_value: the line's meta state before the request
fdesc.drs_poison: the line is poisoned (or the address was out of range)

irqs.name: ERR_RANGE
irqs.desc: a request or write outside the HDM range (reads return poisoned zeros, writes are dropped; both complete)

irqs.name: ERR_OPCODE
irqs.desc: an unsupported opcode: the message was dropped without a response

irqs.name: ERR_PROTO
irqs.desc: a reserved MetaField or SnpType (taken as No-Op)

irqs.name: POISON_RD
irqs.desc: a read returned a poisoned line

notes: The core parameters LINES (16 cache lines of device memory) and RQD (4 Req FIFO entries) keep their defaults; device memory is zero after reset.
